schema.defect: one sentence: what the LABEL said
schema.operation: one sentence: what the OPERATION actually did
schema.bin: INTERVENTION | CONTROL | STATISTIC | SCOPE | PROVENANCE | UNCLASSIFIED
schema.commit: SHA in this repository, must be an ancestor of HEAD
schema.round: which round it was found in or about

note: Bins were fixed in DEFECT_TAXONOMY_PREREGISTRATION.md before any row was written. UNCLASSIFIED is not a dumping ground; it is the pre-registered test of whether the bin set carves anything. THRESHOLD DEFECT, found by the gate firing at n=30: the pre-registered W_C condition is an ABSOLUTE count (a bin >= 8), not a proportion. At n=22 that was 36% of the ledger; at n=30 a bin of 9 is 30% and the same threshold fires. An absolute threshold on a growing ledger makes ONE-JOINT-DOMINATES inevitable. It is NOT changed here -- choosing a threshold after seeing which verdict it produces is the one move this file exists to refuse. The verdict is reported as pre-registered, with the defect stated beside it.

defects.defect: the pre-registration 'fixed the estimator'
defects.operation: it fixed the gate and the target and left the predictor set a class; 60 of 324 admissible estimators return the opposite verdict

defects.defect: leave-one-model-out fold errors 2.2 / 5.0 / 10.5 / 18.7 / 155.9x
defects.operation: quoted from a commit message; the analysis was never saved as a script and no reconstruction over 324 feature sets exceeds 15.6x

defects.defect: 'the floor widens 2.4-5.2x while the effect changes 0.90-1.94x'
defects.operation: neither range reproduces under any floor definition; both quoted from a commit message

defects.defect: the main results table's column is 'effect / floor'
defects.operation: two rows are |eff|/sd, two are |eff|/(p10-p90), two are neither -- three quantities under one column heading

defects.defect: Amendment 2's -18% raw sd / +11% floor
defects.operation: the original-vocabulary run was not checked into the repository, so nothing here could produce them

defects.defect: the sd column read 0.029 for qwen2.5-3b and 0.091 for llama-3.1-8b
defects.operation: true values 0.028 and 0.090; the first appears copied from the row above it

defects.defect: the table showed a null median and IQR per model
defects.operation: those result files predate the runner's percentile keys; the table rendered values the JSON did not contain

defects.defect: '2 sd of a random single head is 0.442 margin units' -- the floor the whole 'seven of eight' claim is measured against
defects.operation: no generator emitted it, and its provenance (the ORIGINAL room vocabulary, not the shipped one) was invisible

defects.defect: ratio_k1 = band floor / sham floor is the pre-registered statistic
defects.operation: the sham arm sits in early layers where an on-distribution write is near-identity; its sd collapses 547x and the ratio divides by it, reporting up to 2133x

defects.defect: mean- and resample-ablation are GENTLER interventions than zeroing
defects.operation: they displace the residual stream by 14-27% of what zeroing does -- three magnitudes, not three kinds

defects.defect: 'randdir separates D from M, the arm R6 did not have'
defects.operation: D and M have IDENTICAL prediction rows; randdir separates {D,M} from S and does nothing between D and M

defects.defect: world F ('being off the manifold matters') predicts constant_only ~ mean
defects.operation: mean writes mu, ON the manifold; constant_only writes off it. The row was derived from the world's NAME and from a label carried over from R7

defects.defect: pc_clears_own_floor means the positive control is live
defects.operation: |PC| > band sd -- magnitude only. randdir's control is sign-INVERTED on 7 of 7 cells across two rounds and passed every time

defects.defect: this repository detects wrong-signed positive controls -- detectors/control_fitness.py
defects.operation: zero callers outside its own file; the detector was dead code while the defect it was written for ran in the data

defects.defect: 'which component you ablate explains 2.7-12.3x more VARIANCE'
defects.operation: the statistic is a ratio of standard deviations; the variance ratio is the square, 7.5-151x

defects.defect: 'R6 and R7 stopped because the mean arm's positive control failed'
defects.operation: true of phi, false of internlm2, which was dropped by the ZERO arm's ratio_k1 = 0.98 -- two exclusion reasons collapsed into one, sixty lines after the same file stated both correctly

defects.defect: internlm2 is 'EXCLUDED by its own sham control' -- the instrument failed there
defects.operation: its zero-arm positive control is 4.69 band sd, second strongest of four. ratio_k1 = 0.98 says early and late heads damage alike, a fact about the model, not a failed control

defects.defect: headline.py printed '-> DIRECTION-MATTERS' as R7's gate result
defects.operation: the pre-registered stopping rule returns NOT MET below 3 included-and-valid cells; the gate code never implemented it and evaluated the bands on 2, contradicting the shipped README

defects.defect: the sham arm controls for THAT you ablated a head
defects.operation: band is the upper half and sham is the early layers, so it controls for that AND for where in the stack; eight rounds inherited the confound

defects.defect: the arms' displacement is matched to 0.00%
defects.operation: matched in HEAD COORDINATES, a basis the model does not privilege; the model sees W_O.delta. Measured afterwards at 1.11x spread against 5.8x permitted, so the label survived -- but not by construction

defects.defect: 'make verify needs no GPU, no network and no dependencies'
defects.operation: it died with ModuleNotFoundError on a fresh clone under the system interpreter; every prior test had been handed the project venv on the command line

defects.defect: detector 6 checks whether a prose number has a generator
defects.operation: its number regex was blind to every ratio in the repository (the 'x' suffix), then to a trailing period, then accepted any prose number whose OWN rounding appeared in the reference set -- 57.9% false-pass on the shape of nearly every number here

defects.defect: 'measure two set sizes and the curve is fixed', 12/12 within 2x
defects.operation: the trivial predictor that ignores k scores 9/12, so the margin is against a floor of 9 and not 0; and of the ten possible pairs the narrowest high-k pair scores 6/12 -- the rule needs two WIDE points, one of them small

defects.defect: 'random component choice accounts for 10% of the measured quantity'
defects.operation: the measured quantity itself sits 10x above any behavioural change: at k=1 the floor is 9.9% and the largest effect 10.4% of the distance to a flipped answer, so the whole comparison is sub-behavioural

defects.defect: 'each detector refuses rather than degrading'
defects.operation: attacked with six inputs derived from their own assumptions, three of five returned a CLEAN verdict on garbage -- including scale=0, which reopened the exact hole the scale argument was made required to close

defects.defect: 'make verify catches any number that drifts from its data'
defects.operation: Detector 6 exempted code fences by design; 184 of 476 README numbers lived there, 54% of the front page. It caught 61%. Removing the exemption surfaced a mistyped digit that had been invisible since it was written

defects.defect: 'every number here traces to a checked-in result file'
defects.operation: true -- and 40 result files traced to nothing. No runner stamped its source; git timestamps show 11 results predate their runner's current code

defects.defect: a job labelled `hook-identity-internlm2-gpu`, submitted to the GPU queue to escape a CPU-only NaN
defects.operation: hook_identity.py hardcoded device_map='cpu'. It ran on the CPU and returned the same NaN, which I read as confirmation rather than as the same run repeated. The label disagreed with the code one level ABOVE the code

defects.defect: hook_identity reported *** HOOK IS MISLABELLED *** on internlm2
defects.operation: all 16 heads returned NaN because the model's vendored CPU path produces an all-NaN forward. NaN is not a large error, it is no measurement. UNVERIFIED folded into OVERTURNED, by a detector on its second invocation

defects.defect: validate_provenance's IMPOSSIBLE verdict
defects.operation: `not older` collapsed False and None, so a file whose git timestamps were simply unknown was convicted; and the producer was INFERRED FROM THE DIRECTORY, so hook_identity's results were compared against R1's runner. Location is a label; the producer is the object

defects.defect: R7's headline ordering `mean < randdir < shrink` in 4 of 4 cells
defects.operation: randdir's positive control is sign-INVERTED on 4 of 4 models, so its readability was |PC|/sd of a control pointing the wrong way. Retracted to `mean < shrink` on 3 of 3 admissible cells

defects.defect: the front page's first sentence: 'almost none report what a random component of the same size does' -- the project's entire novelty premise
defects.operation: FALSE. One arXiv query returned ten of ten relevant papers reporting a random-component control, several as required methodology, including one that samples the null across TEN SEEDS per cell. The query contained the word 'random' so the sample cannot estimate a base rate -- but it refutes a universal negative, which is what the sentence was

defects.defect: two of the eight published effects -- L16H3 and L19H0 -- are among the thirty random draws that define the floor judging them, and L16H3 is that sample's extreme value
defects.operation: CIRCULAR, and conservative. Leaving both out SHRINKS the floor from 0.4418 to 0.4131, so L16H3 clears by MORE (1.13x vs 1.06x) and the count is unchanged. A defect whose sign happens to help the conclusion is still a defect; the control is now in make headline

defects.defect: the headline floor 0.4418 is 2*sd of THIRTY RANDOM DRAWS from a band of 168 heads, while R10 measured all 168 exhaustively in the same vocabulary at the same margin -- the reference class was never itself checked
defects.operation: UNRESOLVED, not wrong. The exhaustive floor is 0.4870 (10.2% higher) and against it the count is 8 of 8, not 7 of 8. A 30-draw floor from this population spans 2.7x between p05 and p95, so the two are the same measurement to within its own resolution. The floor had a noise floor

defects.defect: detector 6 skipped every blockquote line -- 97 of 625 numbers, 15.5%, of which 25 were emitted by no generator and 18 were on the front page
defects.operation: A BLANKET EXEMPTION WITH A SOUND PREMISE. Correction blocks do restate wrong numbers deliberately; but the rule could not name what it exempted, and this repository argues in blockquotes, so every NEW claim written in that style went unchecked too. Replaced by the per-value <!-- unbacked-ok --> marker, which forces each exempt number to be listed next to the sentence needing it

defects.defect: the front page's held-out variance decomposition -- 'on R5's six margin cells the floor carries 52%, effects spanning 3.8x and floors 5.2x'
defects.operation: WITHDRAWN, unreproducible. 28 admissible pairings of R5's checked-in fields span 4.3%-90.8% and NONE lands within 3pp of 52. Third instance after R4 and R5 of the prose fixing the claim and leaving the estimator free. The in-sample half (72.1%, 3.1717 vs 1.2298, 6 cells, 5 distinct floors) reproduces exactly and is now generated

defects.defect: detector 6's own documented invocation -- the example in its docstring -- crashed on relative_to(ROOT) for any relative path argument
defects.operation: BROKEN AND INVISIBLE. make verify passes no arguments and takes the glob branch, whose paths are already absolute, so the only broken path was the one a human would type. Fixed with .resolve()

defects.defect: 'inside the noise floor' was used for nine rounds as one predicate covering two different failures: NOT MEASURABLE (below what the instrument resolves on 120 items) and NOT DISTINCTIVE (resolvable, and a random head of the same size does the same)
defects.operation: SEPARATED, for free, from data already checked in. Every head's drop is a mean over the SAME items, so the item-sampling term appears in every layer and the quietest layer bounds it from above; R10 measured all 28. At most 0.66% of the floor's VARIANCE is item sampling. Against that bound 3 of 8 effects are MEASURABLE (11.8x, 3.4x, 3.3x) and 0 of 8 are DISTINCTIVE. The proven copy head is 3.3x above measurement noise and 0.27x of the floor -- the experiment saw it clearly, and what it saw is not special

defects.defect: detector 6 globbed only **/README.md, so every AMENDMENT_*.md, every PREREGISTRATION.md and the new top-level ADVERSARY.md were outside the checked population
defects.operation: WIDENED to **/*.md: 11 files became 27, and 16 previously invisible unbacked numbers surfaced at once -- including the WITHDRAWN R4 fold errors (155.9x) sitting unguarded in the amendment that withdraws them. Same class as the blockquote exemption removed the same day: a clean report over the wrong POPULATION reads exactly like a clean report over the right one

defects.defect: the exemption marker regex was <!--\\s*unbacked-ok:([^>]*)-->, so a single '>' anywhere inside the exemption's own prose ended the character class early and the whole marker silently did nothing
defects.operation: TRIGGERED BY ITS FIRST REAL USE: ADVERSARY.md's marker contained '>700'. No error, no sign in the report, six numbers flagged as unbacked while carrying an exemption. Fixed to a non-greedy match to '-->'. One character disabling a mechanism is the same shape as the unclosed code fence this detector already refuses on

defects.defect: the detector's own false-pass rate is a function of how many numbers the repository generates, and nothing was measuring it over time
defects.operation: MEASURED AND WATCHED. 17.2% at a reference set of ~500 became 24.34% at >700 in one session -- a 41% relative increase in false passes, caused entirely by adding generators to strengthen the gate. Now printed on EVERY make verify run with a ceiling that fails the build. The ceiling was chosen knowing the current value, so it is stated as NOT a pre-registration

defects.defect: an exemption written in scientific notation (3.55e-05) registers as 3.55 and 05, because the number pattern does not parse exponents -- so it exempts neither value
defects.operation: FIXED by writing the exemption in the table's own decimal notation. The match rule is not the concept, in the mechanism built to enforce that numbers match their concept

defects.defect: the front page led with 'all eight published single-head effects sit inside the noise floor', when 5 of the 8 were read-head CANDIDATES whose set sits at the 46.7th percentile of the null -- there was nothing there to find -- and only 1 (L22H7) was an independently established mechanism
defects.operation: REWRITTEN to lead with the one established mechanism. Predicted by ADVERSARY.md as row A1 BEFORE it was made, and acted on the same day, which means the row can no longer be scored by a real adversary. Recorded as unscoreable rather than quietly dropped

defects.defect: the page led with the provocative reading ('published effects are noise') of data whose honest reading is 'the single head is the wrong unit' -- the k=5 COPY circuit result, 0.0th percentile at -1.4279 against a 4.477 margin, was in the same round the whole time
defects.operation: REWRITTEN. The circuit result now sits beside the single-head number instead of three screens below it. ADVERSARY.md row A3, self-corrected, unscoreable, and recorded as such

defects.defect: both REFUSED branches of the exhaustive runner called Path('results').mkdir -- CWD-relative -- while writing to --out's full path, so a refusal into a not-yet-existing directory raises FileNotFoundError and writes NOTHING
defects.operation: FIXED before the phi-3.5-mini job could hit it (phi has refused before, on n=0 items). The fossil was on disk: an empty untracked results/ in the repo root, created 03:02 by task 41 -- the R9 run that died on its last line with exactly this error. The one branch whose purpose is to leave an honest record of 'this model could not be measured' was the one that could leave nothing but a traceback in a job log

defects.defect: the NEW front-page lead, written one step earlier to fix an overstatement, said the k=5 COPY circuit is at the '0.0th percentile of the null' and added 'Not marginal. Not inside anything.'
defects.operation: OVERSTATED. A percentile from 30 draws resolves to 3.3%: '0.0th' means 'below all thirty' and nothing finer, and the circuit is beyond the most extreme of them by 0.38 sd. On the statistic k=1 already uses -- |effect|/(2*sd of its own null) -- it is 1.45x, i.e. it clears by 45%, not by an order of magnitude. The claim survives, the sentence did not. Both units now reported on one statistic: L22H7 at k=1 is 0.27x, COPY at k=5 is 1.45x, and the k=5 floor is 2.02x larger

defects.defect: the front page's SECOND lead -- 'the single head is the wrong unit' -- written one step earlier to replace an oversold first lead
defects.operation: ALSO WRONG, and wrong in the direction that flattered the project. Ablating all 168 band heads once each: 9 CLEAR the exhaustive floor at k=1, up to 2.54x. Single-head ablation resolves effects here perfectly well. What it does not do is rank the eight published heads anywhere near the top -- they sit at 10, 55, 56, 109, 113, 115, 116, 143 of 168, and the independently proven copy head is 56th. Zero of the nine clearing heads is among the eight. Third front page in three steps; all three kept and annotated

defects.defect: _PRODUCER recorded Path(__file__).name -- a BASENAME. Eleven rounds all call their script run.py, so the provenance check looked it up with a glob, took whichever candidate sorted first, and reported producer_guessed_from_path = False
defects.operation: IT CONVICTED R11's RESULT AGAINST R6's RUNNER. The earlier fix -- 'read the producer from the file, do not infer it from the directory' -- was right and incomplete: what the file recorded could not name the object either. Now a repo-relative path in all 12 runners, and a basename matching more than one file is treated as a GUESS, which cannot convict

defects.defect: the IMPOSSIBLE branch fired on a result whose stamp matched no CURRENT runner and whose runner had not been committed since -- concluding the stamp could not have come from that runner
defects.operation: FALSE CONVICTION, on exactly the scenario the stamp exists to reveal: a 16-minute job holds the source it loaded, so editing and committing the runner mid-run leaves the result carrying the PRE-EDIT hash while git reports no movement. Stamps are now resolved against every committed version of the runner, not just HEAD; a stamp found in history is reported as STALE with the reason, and cannot be called impossible
